review: app wont let me log in, randomly signed me out and I cant even use my password to log back in. sends me to an email link to login and then link doesnt work.

They seem to have fixed the inability to reach the Monopoly game mode when there is a recent order showing in the app, by often having it on the home screen in the What's New section -- that puts this back up to four stars in my book! Also I was delighted to learn that I can turn off the super long animations for Monopoly. Much appreciated!

this is genuinely one of the worst fast food apps to exist period. the amount of weird glitches that just make it impossible to even attempt ordering food is laughable. currently my app thinks im making a pick up order when i havent even started an order, and its making it impossible to get a delivery. another bug was the app thinking it was morning when it was the middle of the day, so it was impossible for me to order any food at all. youd think that mcdonalds would actually fix some of this

Cannot even order after latest update I can get to the checkout then it just loads and breaks over and over again. super annoying, but probably healthier for me than the McDonalds breakfast I wanted. have tried logging out and back in, and uninstalling then reinstalling. just straight up broken app.
Garbage app. Offer codes constantly don't work or can't be used due to error.

I am getting a lot of offers for mcdelivery only instead of one that can be used in all mobile order types. when I always buy in person I find this annoying as it not relevant to me at all. especially when seeing other family members offer being more relevant.
This app is getting worse. Slow to load. Often have to close app and open again to get menus or codes to load. I prefer to order from other restaurants because this app is junk.
